name: CodeLearn
tagline: A technical dictionary you actually remember: 349 dev, cloud and AI terms with spaced repetition.
description: CodeLearn is a dictionary of technical vocabulary (dev, systems, networking, cloud, security, AI) that you memorise. Every term has a plain definition, an analogy, a code sample, the classic pitfalls and a quiz, and a spaced-repetition engine brings back the terms you are about to forget. No account, no network. The interface is in French.
